newsitem.title: USA: Gwinnett Cty, Ga., to vote on sales tax increase.
newsitem.headline: Gwinnett Cty, Ga., to vote on sales tax increase.

text.p: Georgia's Gwinnett County Commission voted unanimously Tuesday to hold a referendum on a one-cent sales tax increase, a commission spokeswoman said.
The proposal will go on the Nov 5 ballot, an aide to Commission Chairman Wayne Hill said. New revenues would finance park, library and public safety projects.
Last November, Gwinnett County voters defeated a sales tax increase that would have been used to build more roads.
